answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed when duplicate or fraudulent behaviour is proven, so creating thousands of fake agents costs real capital rather than just code. A violet badge could mark identities with a long, clean attestation history, like a sonnet that only earns its lines over time, while a single ember of fraud burns the stake and the reputation together. Attackers can still try, but each fake identity now carries a price they cannot recycle for free.
